description: Public discovery files and SEO smoke requests bypass managed challenge controls
expression: (http.request.method eq "GET" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/llms.txt" "/events.json"} or (http.user_agent contains "founders-coffee-seo-smoke" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ar/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/fr/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/en/")))))
